authority: Line owner 2026-10-16 production-line optimisation plan §7: the review must bind the request that is actually sent.  Receipts bound prompt and reference FILES; the H3 re-render, reference reordering, voice attachment and send-time compression all happen after them.  Line owner 2026-11-01 item 3: make it impossible for 'the data actually sent' to differ from 'the data that was reviewed'. Line owner 2026-11-01 follow-up: (1) from E14 the send-time review binding is ENFORCED — the reviewed request, model, prompts, references and payload are checked before the final request goes out, a mismatch means re-review, and an unreviewed task may not be paid-submitted; (2) a receipt binding is enforced too, with a bounded refusal.
activation_note: From E14 on, every task must carry reviewed_request_sha256 (stamp with tools/provider_request_digest.py stamp --manifest after the review, before paid authorization).  E01-E13 are sealed and unaffected.  Bounded refusal: only the task whose binding is missing, wrong or in conflict is held; its media may not enter later production or the final cut, while every other independent task keeps running in parallel.  A task the provider may already have accepted but whose receipt is lost or whose local binding failed goes to PENDING_RECONCILIATION: query, download and binding completion stay allowed, the budget reservation or unresolved charge risk is kept, and the task is NEVER POSTed again to repair a binding.  The episode as a whole is not blocked by an unrelated task's binding.

blocking.note: The refusal at the paid boundary is per task and already exists; it applies only to an episode named above.  Nothing here adds a batch step, a lock or an extra provider call: the digest is computed from values the submitter already holds, and the receipt binder reads a transaction file that is already on disk.  Every other rule in this file ships off and is reported, not enforced.

receipt_binding.join: request sha on both sides: the transaction's request_binding.request_sha256 must equal the record's provider_request.request_sha256
refuses: RECEIPT_NOT_REQUEST_BOUND: the transaction carries no request_binding.request_sha256
RECEIPT_FOR_ANOTHER_REQUEST: the transaction POSTed a different request than the one reviewed
REQUEST_SHA_CHANGED_SINCE_REVIEW: the review request file on disk no longer hashes to what the record says was reviewed
REVIEW_REQUEST_MISSING: the review request file is gone
TASK_ID_NOT_BOUND: the transaction carries no provider task id yet
receipt_binding.writes: the evidence record the tool is pointed at (--record); the tool never writes into workflow/ and takes every path as an argument
receipt_binding.activation_note: Enforced from E14.  A task whose receipt carries no request binding, a different request, a changed request sha, or no provider task identifier is held as PENDING_RECONCILIATION with the bounds above: its media does not reach the cut, nothing is re-POSTed to repair it, and the rest of the batch continues.

review_media.note: Item 4.  For keyframe / start_frame / video_q2 requests the reviewer is shown the identity / wardrobe / space / prop reference images that the task itself was given, each labelled with its role and version (source + transport sha).  A reference the authoring manifest names but the file system no longer has is ALWAYS listed as MISSING — that half has no switch, because omitting it silently is the failure this rule exists to stop.  The request also states, as an answer rule, that identity agreement may not be claimed from the generated image alone when identity_reference_status is MISSING; that half is gated by identity_claim_requires_reference.

legacy_behaviour.sealed_episodes: byte-identical: no field is required, no stage refuses, and every record says UNENFORCED for the policy it is outside of

status_vocabulary.UNENFORCED: the policy does not cover this episode; nothing was checked — this is not a pass
status_vocabulary.MATCH: a review is bound and the request about to be sent is that request
status_vocabulary.MISMATCH: a review is bound and the request about to be sent differs — refused before any POST
status_vocabulary.MISSING: the policy covers this episode and no review is bound — refused
status_vocabulary.VALID: a stored binding still describes the request in hand
status_vocabulary.INVALID: prompt text, a reference file, the model or the payload changed — re-review required

authorization_followup_2026_11_01: Line owner 2026-11-01 follow-up: required as a STEP (the script cannot be marked complete for paid prep without a completed review and the writer's answers to every question; Rule 8 must carry a grounded answer or a NOT_APPLICABLE reason). Creative judgement stays REPORT-ONLY: an AI opinion that a hook is weak, the pace slow or the emotion thin is a revision note in E14, never an automatic veto by score or a single judgement. Cross-shot detections are OBSERVE-ONLY in E14: record evidence, confidence and disposition to learn the false-positive rate; they do not block, and a clearly confirmed serious problem is still handled while an uncertain one is never recorded as a pass.
